issues.title: Node content and port escaping bounding container
issues.description: The secondary content section and output port of the bottom canvas node render completely outside the node's dashed border frame onto the raw canvas grid.
issues.evidence: In the 'Nightly reconciliation' node, the text 'Scheduled branch — detached from the live flow...' and its right-hand connector dot float outside the dashed node box.
issues.suggestion: Update CanvasNode layout so the bounding box encloses all internal branch metadata columns and handles internal overflow appropriately.
issues.triageNote: The 'Scheduled branch — detached…' text is a page-authored sibling <div> placed next to the CanvasNode in pair-062 (not component content), and the output port dot intentionally straddles the edge midpoint per the documented wiring contract; the node's own children/title/footer are fully enclosed (title ellipsizes via overflow-hidden + text-ellipsis).

issues.title: Illegible low-contrast text on inactive node
issues.description: Text inside the inactive/paused canvas node is rendered in an extremely faint gray with virtually no contrast against the light canvas background.
issues.evidence: The body text 'Generates the finance reconciliation workbook...', metadata 'last run · 02:00 UTC 14m 06s', and footer 'report · finance-recon' in the bottom-left node fail readability and WCAG contrast thresholds.
issues.suggestion: Increase the text contrast token for muted/paused canvas nodes to ensure text maintains at least a 4.5:1 contrast ratio against the background.
issues.triageNote: Real defect: the disabled variant's root opacity-40 dimmed every text token (body neutral-600 → ~1.7:1, footer neutral-400 → ~1.5:1 on the light canvas); replaced whole-node opacity with chrome-only dimming (dashed neutral-300 border + neutral-600 title) so content keeps full contrast.

issues.title: Awkward line wrapping in node metric values
issues.description: Numeric metric values in the error node wrap mid-phrase onto separate lines, creating a fragmented and confusing readout.
issues.evidence: In the 'Sync to Snowflake war...' node, 'retries · 3 of' wraps with '3' on the line below, and 'backoff ·' wraps with '30s' below it.
issues.suggestion: Apply 'white-space: nowrap' to metric value pairs or provide sufficient column width within the node body.
issues.triageNote: The metric rows ('retries · 3 of 3' / 'backoff · 30s') are page-authored justify-between flex spans in pair-062 with no nowrap; the component's body slot is a generic padded column and cannot know page-authored spans are atomic metrics.

issues.title: Low contrast node path text
issues.description: Footer metadata within the canvas nodes has low contrast against the card background.
issues.evidence: Faint text such as 'src/IMG_4821.cr3' and 'recipe/fjord-dusk' is difficult to read.
issues.suggestion: Increase text opacity or use a darker neutral token for node metadata.
issues.triageNote: The faint 'src/IMG_4821.cr3' / 'recipe/fjord-dusk' spans carry a page-authored text-neutral-400 class (2.2:1 on the white panel) inside the pass-through footer slot — eval pages are not editable; the component demo taught the same failing pattern, so demo.tsx footers were stepped up to neutral-600 (5.3:1 light / 7.3:1 dark).
